text: {"title":"API Errors — Last Hour","timeRange":{"from":"now-1h","to":"now"},"refreshIntervalMs":15000,"panels":[{"id":"errors-over-time","title":"API error volume over time","description":"Counts API log lines at level error per 5-minute bucket, summed into a single series over the dashboard window.","viz":"line","format":"number","query":{"sourceId":"eval-loki-demo","logql":"sum(count_over_time({app=\"api\", level=\"error\"}[5m]))"},"options":{"unit":"errors","legend":"none","yAxis":{"min":0,"label":"errors per 5m"}},"layout":{"x":0,"y":0,"w":6,"h":4}},{"id":"errors-total","title":"Total API errors (window)","description":"Computes the total number of API log lines at level error over the last hour as a single value.","viz":"stat","format":"number","query":{"sourceId":"eval-loki-demo","logql":"sum(count_over_time({app=\"api\", level=\"error\"}[1h]))","instant":true},"options":{"unit":"errors","decimals":0},"layout":{"x":6,"y":0,"w":6,"h":4}},{"id":"errors-by-container","title":"API errors by container","description":"Compares the number of API log lines at level error over the last hour across containers.","viz":"bar","format":"number","query":{"sourceId":"eval-loki-demo","logql":"sum by (container) (count_over_time({app=\"api\", level=\"error\"}[1h]))","instant":true},"options":{"unit":"errors","decimals":0,"legend":"none"},"layout":{"x":0,"y":4,"w":6,"h":4}},{"id":"error-lines","title":"API error log lines","description":"Shows the most recent API log lines at level error so a reader can inspect the individual error messages.","viz":"logs","query":{"sourceId":"eval-loki-demo","logql":"{app=\"api\", level=\"error\"}"},"options":{"limit":200,"level":"level","order":"newest","showTime":true,"wrap":true},"layout":{"x":6,"y":4,"w":6,"h":4}}]}
